annotations.title: Compare AI tools on verified prices

description: Preview a price comparison of 2-5 Atlas tools for a usage scenario, computed without a model from plan editions checked against the vendors' own pricing pages. First category: AI transcription (seats, minutes a month, required capabilities). Returns per tool the cheapest fitting verified plan, or why there is none (unknown, ineligible, contact sales, stale) - unknown is never shown as missing or free. Nothing is saved; atlas_dataset_create keeps it for a website. Free; sixty a day per address.

productIds.description: Atlas domains, e.g. "otter.ai"; resolve names with atlas_search first.

required.description: Capabilities a plan must have to count (up to three).

scenario.description: The usage the price is worked out for.

currency.description: ISO code; plans in other currencies are not converted. Default USD.

longestRecording.description: Longest single recording in minutes, when per-recording caps matter.

volume.description: Minutes of audio transcribed per month across the team.

name: atlas_compare
